now: I'm building Threemates, a software development studio based in Bhubaneswar. We design ERP systems, SaaS platforms, and web & mobile applications that help businesses digitize their operations and scale efficiently.
Alongside Threemates, I lead backend engineering at Rabinnson — multi-tenant Spring Boot microservices on PostgreSQL with role-based access control and audit logging across multiple legal entities.

On the frontend, I build React dashboards with real-time data visualization and export for compliance workflows, and I've integrated payment gateways and identity-verification APIs behind a Dockerized CI/CD pipeline.
